visual.general_description: H and E stained section showing a vessel with a dense inflammatory cell cuff in fatty tissue, with a low-power slide thumbnail inset.
visual.detailed_description: Hematoxylin and eosin style purple and pink stained tissue at medium to high power. A central muscular-walled vessel is surrounded by a dense cuff of small dark-nucleated inflammatory cells, with a thickened pink vessel wall. Pale fat vacuoles of adipose tissue fill the left and lower regions. Other thick-walled vessels containing red blood cells appear at the upper left, upper right and right, and a large red congested or hemorrhagic area lies at the lower left. A small inset at the upper right shows a low-power thumbnail of four tissue strips with a small green mark. No scale bar, panel letters or text labels are legible.
